name: Cooperative-groups thread-block rank sum
description: A whole-thread-block cooperative_groups partition drives a shared-memory tree reduction (sumReduction) of each thread's rank; every block sums ranks 0..255 to the triangular number 32640.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: sumReduction reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples simpleCooperativeGroups.cu. cgkernel is adapted to write g_odata[blockIdx.x] instead of printf and drops the tiled_partition<16> sub-reduction; host driver, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-05.
notes: Real-extraction cooperative-groups reduction case from collection snapshot sk-05. blockDim=256, grid=16 -> 16 outputs, each 32640. Exact integer oracle.
